purpose: Separate market-state prediction from strategy-PnL conditioning so indicator research explains future regime first and only then asks whether the frozen trading logic benefits from that regime.

directionality.description: Future directional efficiency rather than raw return sign.
directionality.goal: distinguish persistent directional movement from chop

volatility.description: Future realized volatility/range relative to a trailing causal baseline.
volatility.goal: distinguish expansion, normal and contraction regimes

liquidity.description: Future tradability and execution quality independent of strategy PnL.

continuation_reversion.description: Whether a current displacement persists or mean-reverts over the next horizon.

questions: Is the market trending, transitioning or ranging?
Is trend direction consistent across 15m and 1h?
Does trend strength add information beyond simple EMA state?
Is volatility compressed, normal or expanding?
Do order-flow signals work only when expected movement can exceed friction?
Is displayed liquidity supportive or fragile?
Does directional book pressure persist after controlling for spread and depth?
Is aggressive flow persistent, exhausted or divergent from price?
Does flow acceleration add information beyond static CVD?
Is current displacement stretched enough to favor reversion?
Does order flow confirm exhaustion versus continuation?
Is the altcoin moving idiosyncratically or as BTC beta?
Does BTC lead the signal or merely co-move with it?
Is positioning crowded or expanding with price?
Does the same order-flow signal behave differently under leverage crowding?
derivatives_positioning.availability_rule: Use only fields available from legitimate zero-additional-cost public/existing data sources; missing derivatives fields do not block other research.

questions: Are signal properties stable across sessions?
Are apparent edges concentrated in one narrow time bucket?
Is a statistically predictive state economically tradeable?
How much of gross predictability survives realistic friction?

synthesis_rules.primary_objective: incremental predictive information about future market state and net executable expectancy, not standalone in-sample profit factor
redundancy_control: prefer one representative from highly redundant indicator clusters
measure incremental lift after conditioning on already-selected regime variables
synthesis_rules.multiple_testing: All promoted condition hypotheses must enter the trial accounting/freeze workflow before later validation.
synthesis_rules.transfer: Cross-pair tests use unchanged definitions and are transfer evidence only until a new frozen candidate is evaluated on later untouched data.

anti_overfit_rules: Do not change indicator definitions or bucket boundaries because one batch looked attractive.
Do not select the best of many indicators solely by maximum PF.
Do not combine indicators unless each adds incremental information or a pre-specified interaction hypothesis exists.
Do not label already-inspected historical periods as OOS.
Do not use strategy PnL to choose the initial cross-pair universe.
Do not weaken transaction-cost assumptions to rescue an indicator.
